candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` so deposits never update the caller's recorded balance.
Change `+=` to `=` so the balance is overwritten with msg.value instead of accumulating the deposit.
Change `+=` to `-=` so deposits subtract value, reverting on underflow and reducing balances when sufficient funds exist.
Credit `tx.origin` instead of `msg.sender`, so the deposit is recorded under a different address key.
Remove the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer changes MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum += _val;' so the new value is the old value plus _val.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so MinSum ends up one larger than in P.
Remove the guard 'if(intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum can still change MinSum after initialization, unlike in P.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never changes MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value differs from the original.
Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so MinSum can also be changed after initialization, altering observable MinSum values in later states.
Delete the statement that assigns Log, leaving Log at its default value.
Replace the assignment with Log = LogFile(msg.sender), storing the caller's address instead of the supplied argument.
Delete the initialized guard so a later call can overwrite Log even after initialization.
